speaker: caller
text: Hello, this is the courier service. We have a parcel under your name that is held at customs.

speaker: receiver
text: A parcel? I'm not expecting anything.

speaker: caller
text: It was sent from overseas and the declared contents do not match, so customs has flagged it.

speaker: caller
text: I will connect you to the customs enforcement officer. Please hold.

speaker: caller
text: Good afternoon, I am Officer Lim from Singapore Customs. You are being investigated for importing prohibited items.

speaker: receiver
text: Prohibited items? I never ordered anything like that.

speaker: caller
text: If you do not resolve this today, we will refer your case to the police and the parcel will be destroyed.

speaker: caller
text: You need to pay a release fee of four hundred and eighty dollars through PayNow.

speaker: caller
text: I will send you the number now. Pay within one hour, otherwise the fine will double.

speaker: caller
text: After you pay, take a screenshot of the receipt and send it to me on WhatsApp.
